mentions.name: NewsNinja
mentions.description: Feed reader app, now being developed as version 3.0, which will add more feed types including podcasts, Mastodon, Twitter/X, calendars, reminders, weather, and finance tickers, plus a new UI, notifications, local transcripts and summaries, and other quality-of-life improvements.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on version 3.0 of my feed reader app NewsNinja: https://ainews.ninja

Version 3 will add more feed types: Podcasts, Mastodon, Twitter/X, Calendar, Reminders, Weather, Finance tickers and more.

It will have a new UI, new features like notifications and local transcripts and summaries and many quality of life improvements.
